company.name: Monterey AI
company.shortDescription: Monterey AI is a product development copilot that helps clients collect feedback and drive insights.
company.description:
Monterey AI is a product development copilot that helps clients collect feedback and drive insights by providing intelligent customer voice infrastructure for product operations teams in hyper-growth firms. Monterey AI assists companies in determining what measures to take to boost engagement and minimize churn by establishing user feedback channels, gathering and analyzing qualitative and quantitative data from numerous sources.

Monterey AI is headquartered in San Francisco, California and was founded in 2022.
